fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingFuelType.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListing [biFuel] [en] — Bi Fuel Trucks TC-CL-04: Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Bi Fuel Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CL-04
**Title:** Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Bi Fuel Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Bi Fuel Trucks page, click the "Still confused?" widget's Call Now button to open the assistance lead form, fill model, name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
The assistance form closes after a successful submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Bi Fuel Trucks page
2. Click Call Now to open the assistance lead form
3. Fill model, name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the assistance form closes
